subject: New remittance address for check payments
text:
Dear Valued Customer,

Brightline Office Supply Inc. has moved its payment processing to a new lockbox. Please update your records to send all check payments to:

Brightline Office Supply Inc.
Dept. 3307
PO Box 790126
St. Louis, MO 63179-0126

Our previous remittance address, PO Box 22841, Columbus, OH, will be closed on December 15. Mail sent there after that date will not be forwarded.

Our corporate office address is not changing. ACH customers do not need to take any action at this time.

Thank you,
Brightline Accounts Receivable
label: change_request
note: Borderline: a check lockbox (remit-to) move, not an office move. The lockbox is where check money lands, so this is new remittance instructions. ACH customers are told no action is needed, which a detector might over-weight.
